answer: Newcomers earn standing with a ridge-line star-fix ledger. Over 30 nights each newcomer charts 18 star fixes along a ridge, and two established navigators countersign every fix in a day, logging it in quill ink. A fix off by more than 2 degrees loses its credit and freezes rewards for 21 days, and three bad fixes wipe the ledger clean. Faking 1,000 agents takes 18,000 fixes and 36,000 verifications, $180,000 in sextants and 54,000 hours of night work, while a single honest agent just charts its ridge. Trust gathers the way a nebula gathers dust into stars, one fix at a time.
